      - blank -> blank (no displayed count)

      - text containing comma/semicolon/newline/slash-separated day entries -> count non-empty entries
      - text date ranges like '1-3' or '1 to 3' are expanded inclusively when unambiguous
      - otherwise one non-empty text token counts as one day
    """

    if isinstance(value, (datetime, date, time)):
